title: FP8->INT8 profile override + targeted calibration for transactional-risk model
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Northbridge Capital (private deployment) reported a measurable accuracy regression after switching their transactional-risk model to our FP8 production profile. They request an INT8 fallback profile with a customer-approved override and a focused calibration run against their held-out dataset. This ticket drives the engineering work to produce a validated INT8 profile, document the override workflow for Private customers, and implement automation so the calibration can be repeated safely by support/SEs.
acceptance_criteria: [1] Reproduce accuracy regression locally against the customer-provided eval set and baseline FP16 numbers. [2] Produce an INT8 configuration that meets customer accuracy SLA: max 0.25% absolute drop in weighted F1 vs FP16 on their eval set. [3] Provide a documented override workflow (RBAC) and a repeatable calibration job in the private control plane. [4] Add telemetry to detect production drift for this customer and a rollback runbook. [5] Obtain sign-off from PM, Solutions Eng, and customer security contact.
plan: 1) Repro step: pull customer eval snapshot (s3://rbw-northbridge/rrisk-eval-v2), run baseline FP16 inference on dedicated GPU host, and capture metrics. 2) Run our existing INT8 quant pipeline with per-layer symmetric/asymmetric tests, then measure distribution shifts. 3) If initial INT8 fails, investigate per-module (attention/ffn) FP8 hybrid paths and mixed-precision thresholds. 4) Iterate on per-channel scale calibration and KL-divergence clipping heuristics. 5) Prepare override package (config + signed policy) and deploy to customer's private control plane for verification. 6) Merge monitoring hooks and create dashboard tile in Console.
test_plan:
- Unit: quant code path unit tests (coverage for per-channel scale and fallback)
- Integration: run end-to-end pipeline on a dedicated small cluster (A100 x2) using customer eval set, compare against FP16 baseline.
- Regression: run the model on Redwood internal regression harness (subset of 10k transactions) to catch edge-case class drops.
- Customer validation: provide results and artifact bundle to Northbridge for independent verification.
rollout_plan: 1) Stay in Private staging for customer only (no hosted exposure). 2) After customer sign-off, apply the override config in their dedicated pool with traffic shadowing for 24h. 3) If metrics within threshold, shift 5% production traffic for 2h, then 25% for 12h, then full switch. 4) Auto-fallback policy: if weighted F1 drops >0.3% or latency increases >25% vs baseline, automatically revert to FP8 production profile and page on-call.
monitoring: Create Console dashboard: weighted F1 (customer eval), per-class recall/precision, tail latency p99, token throughput, and quantization-activation-distribution histogram. Add alert: regression-risk if F1 delta > 0.2% sustained for 30m. Link to runbook: confluence.redwood.internal/rrisk-quant-override-runbook.
comments: 2025-11-07 - Aisha Patel: Received request from Solutions Eng (SE) after Northbridge detected a 0.9% drop in weighted F1 post-deploy. SE attached eval snapshot and baseline numbers. Filed ticket and assigned to Marco.

2025-11-09 - Marco Ruiz: Reproduced regression on A100 staging host. Baseline FP16 weighted F1 0.872, FP8 deployed profile 0.863. Initial INT8 run (default per-channel) returned 0.854 — too low. Captured activation distributions and serialized them for analysis.

2025-11-11 - Marco Ruiz: Tried per-layer asymmetric scaling for attention layers — improved to 0.868. Noted that the ffn kernel quant noise concentrated in high-frequency features. Logged detailed diff to GitHub PR 4289.

2025-11-13 - ML Infra review (Lena Chen): Suggested KL clipping at layer norms and enabling bias-correction in per-channel quant to reduce outlier effects. Also recommended a small calibration set focused on rare-event classes from customer's snapshot.

2025-11-14 - Marco Ruiz: Implemented KL clipping and bias-correction flags. New INT8 config reached 0.871 on customer eval — within target (0.001 delta). Created calibration job template (private-calib-job-templates/rrisk-int8) and uploaded artifacts to S3.

2025-11-16 - Solutions Eng (Priya Nair): Ran internal validation with customer's team. They requested that we keep an explicit signed override document and an option to revert without redeploying model binaries. Added requirement to plan for that in the control plane.

2025-11-18 - Marco Ruiz: Drafted override package and associated policy. Implemented an API-level flag (customer_override_id) and a small RBAC gate so only Tenant Admin + Redwood SE can apply the override. Integration tests green locally.

2025-11-20 - PM (Jordan Blake): Reviewed plan and asked for monitoring tile and automatic rollback threshold. Approved moving to customer staging for validation. Updated due date to 2025-11-28 to allow for customer QA window.
